editorial.blurb: A neighborhood sushi spot beloved by regulars for years, offering solid rolls and bowls at accessible prices with genuinely warm service.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the sushi or yakisoba—these are what keep customers coming back; skip the teriyaki beef bowl, which reviewers found oversauced and tough.

topDishes.note: Great quality for the price, especially praised by long-time regulars
A reliable favorite that keeps customers returning
